what: Field values a vision model transcribed that are not text on the page it cited. Recorded before the Candidates that carried them were deleted; they cannot be regenerated, because re-extracting produces different wrong rows.
why: The empirical basis of ADR-0006 and the regression corpus for field-token verification. Every entry here must stay flagged; if a change to the checker stops flagging one, that is a loosening somebody should have to justify.
what_is_not_claimed: These are not all model errors. Some are the checker's own limit: where the page's text stream glued a correct value to its neighbour (`freeway1148+60`), the checker cannot see the value and flags a row that is right. Separating the two mechanically was attempted and does not work — `Phonosc ope` against a page reading `phonoscope` is the model splitting a word, and `1148+60` against `freeway1148+60` is the page gluing one, and both look identical to a substring test. So the evidence is recorded and the verdict is not. `page_tokens_containing_an_absent_one` is the field to filter on; entries with it are the ambiguous ones.
